source.author: verg
source.text: Certatim instaurant epulas atque omine magno crateras laeti statuunt et vina coronant.
source.text_original: Certatim instaurant epulas atque omine magno / crateras laeti statuunt et vina coronant.
source.text_english: In eager rivalry they renew the feast and, with a great omen, joyfully set up the mixing bowls and crown the wine.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Then they gladly set up altars.
